ratioSetting.title: Pricing Settings
ratioSetting.description: Manage model pricing configurations and options.
ratioSetting.deleteDescription: Are you sure you want to delete model {{name}}? This action cannot be undone.

modelRatioNotSet.selectModelBatch: Please select models to batch set first
modelRatioNotSet.description: This page only shows models with unset prices or ratios. They will be removed from the list automatically after setting.
modelRatioNotSet.batchSetDesc: Will set the same value for the selected {{count}} models
modelRatioNotSet.setBothRatio: Set both model and completion ratios

upstreamRatio.selectChannelFirst: Please select a sync channel and start sync first
upstreamRatio.selectChannelDesc: Select channels to fetch ratio configurations

modelRatioSettings.modelPricePlaceholder: A JSON text where keys are model names and values are cost per call in USD. E.g., "gpt-4-gizmo-*": 0.1 means $0.1 per call.
modelRatioSettings.modelPriceDesc: Cost per call in USD, takes precedence over model ratio.
modelRatioSettings.jsonMapModelToRatio: A JSON text where keys are model names and values are ratios.
modelRatioSettings.imageRatioLabel: Image Input Ratio (Supported by some models)
modelRatioSettings.imageRatioPlaceholder: A JSON text where keys are model names and values are ratios. E.g., {"gpt-image-1": 2}
modelRatioSettings.imageRatioDesc: Image input ratio settings. Keys are model names, values are ratios. Only supported by some models.
modelRatioSettings.audioRatioPlaceholder: A JSON text where keys are model names and values are ratios. E.g., {"gpt-4o-audio-preview": 16}
modelRatioSettings.audioRatioDesc: Audio input ratio settings. Keys are model names, values are ratios.
modelRatioSettings.audioCompletionRatioLabel: Audio Completion Ratio (Supported by some models)
modelRatioSettings.audioCompletionRatioPlaceholder: A JSON text where keys are model names and values are ratios. E.g., {"gpt-4o-realtime": 2}
modelRatioSettings.audioCompletionRatioDesc: Audio output completion ratio settings. Keys are model names, values are ratios.
modelRatioSettings.confirmReset: Are you sure you want to reset model ratios?

groupRatioSettings.invalidJsonArray: Must be a valid JSON string array, e.g., ["g1","g2"]
groupRatioSettings.jsonMapGroupToRatio: A JSON text where keys are group names and values are ratios.
groupRatioSettings.groupRatioDesc: Group ratio settings. Add new groups or modify existing ones here. Format: JSON string. E.g., {"vip": 0.5, "test": 1} means VIP group ratio is 0.5, Test group ratio is 1.
groupRatioSettings.userUsableGroups: Groups available when users create new projects
groupRatioSettings.jsonMapGroupToDesc: A JSON text where keys are group names and values are group descriptions.
groupRatioSettings.userUsableGroupsDesc: Groups available for users when creating tokens. Format: JSON string. E.g., {"vip": "VIP User", "test": "Test"} means users can select VIP and Test groups.
groupRatioSettings.groupGroupRatioDesc: Keys are group names, values are JSON objects where keys are group names and values are special ratios. E.g., {"vip": {"default": 0.5, "test": 1}} means VIP users have a 0.5 ratio for default tokens and 1 for test tokens.
groupRatioSettings.groupSpecialUsableGroupDesc: Keys are user group names, values are operation maps. Keys starting with "+:" add groups (value is description), "-:" remove groups. Keys without prefix add groups directly. E.g., {"vip": {"+:premium": "Premium", "special": "Special", "-:default": "Default"}} adds Premium/Special access and removes Default for VIP users.
groupRatioSettings.autoGroups: Auto Groups (Selects from the first available)
groupRatioSettings.defaultUseAutoGroup: Default to 'auto' group for new tokens
groupRatioSettings.defaultUseAutoGroupDesc: Initial token will also be set to 'auto' (otherwise empty, defaulting to user's group).
groupRatioSettings.contentSafetyDesc: Whether to enable content safety interception, which will check user inputs for safety.
